name: Aqua Bloom
description: Water-element magic skill for Enchanter. Its damage formula was corrected and rebalanced in v1.1.6.

name: Body Slam
description: Jump into the air and slam down for AoE damage that scales with DEF. Pulls nearby enemies toward you and stuns them.

name: Tailwind
description: Leap backward while dealing continuous damage and pushing enemies back by 1 stud.

name: Blade Rush
description: Dash forward and slash enemies in your path. Has 2 charges within a 3-second window and a 7-second cooldown after the charges are used.

name: Doombell
description: Summons a giant bell over an area, dealing impact damage, stunning enemies, and applying Burn damage over time.

name: Whirlwind
description: Changed in v1.1.6 to scale with DEF instead of PATK. Damage scaling increased from 100% to 400%.

name: Timber Charge
description: Hit behavior and damage were improved in the July 30 patch. It stuns non-demihumans for 1 second. In v1.1.8 it gained crowd-control immunity during use; deferred CC applies after the skill ends, except Timber Charge versus Timber Charge.
source: Official Discord big-updates and announcements tabs
